sounds.title: Your sounds
sounds.description: One row per sound. Press Choose file to add an MP3, WAV or OGG file from this PC. A chat command and reward IDs are optional; every sound gets a button in the Control Panel.

volume.title: Overall volume (%)
volume.description: Multiplied with each sound's own volume.

letSoundsOverlap.title: Let sounds play over each other
letSoundsOverlap.description: Off: a new sound stops the one playing.

longestSoundSeconds.title: Cut sounds off after (seconds)
longestSoundSeconds.description: A safety limit so a long file never plays on and on.

commandPlatforms.title: Chats that can use the sound commands

commandAccess.title: Who can play sounds by chat command
commandAccess.description: You and your moderators always can. Rewards always play, because the viewer paid for them.

globalCooldownSeconds.title: Wait between any two chat sounds (seconds)

soundCooldownSeconds.title: Wait before the same sound again (seconds)

cooldownMessage.title: Cooldown reply (optional)
cooldownMessage.description: Leave empty to stay quiet. Placeholders: {viewer}, {sound}, {seconds}.

listCommand.title: Command that lists the sounds (optional)
listCommand.description: For example sounds, so viewers type !sounds. Leave empty for none.

stopCommand.title: Moderator command that stops all sounds (optional)
stopCommand.description: For example stopsounds. Only you and your moderators can use it.
